question: How does the time-devouring yogin become a sky-mover?
premises: the yogin intent on devouring time becomes a sky-mover
time is the appearance of things
time is of the nature of limitation
inference: devouring time removes limitation and makes the yogin a sky-mover
plain_english: The yogin intent on devouring time becomes a sky-mover in an instant, for time, the appearance of things, is of the nature of limitation.
